items.headline: Fed Sept-meeting minutes show most officials favor one more hike by year-end; weak Sept payrolls cut Oct 28 hike odds to ~20%
items.why: Shifts rate-path expectations from the Oct 28 FOMC meeting toward December, repricing short-end rates and the dollar

items.headline: Beijing unveils new mini-stimulus package, its biggest since Sept 2024, to shore up growth
items.why: Signals Beijing still cautious on broad easing ('a nudge, not a game-changer'), key read for China growth and commodity demand into year-end

items.headline: Bloomberg: Nvidia faces scrutiny over AI chips reaching China via Southeast Asia smuggling schemes despite export curbs
items.why: Highlights enforcement gaps in US chip export controls and political pressure on Nvidia's China exposure

items.headline: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise at least $30B at a $1.4T valuation as IPO timeline slips to 2027
items.why: Would be the largest-ever private tech valuation and signals OpenAI prioritizing capital/safety runway over a near-term listing
